# Alvenqis Network

> Independent Rust L1 Proof-of-Work blockchain (FiroPoW 0.9.4, account-based, unit ALVE).
> Status: Mainnet Candidate / Experimental Prototype. ALVE is not real money at this stage.
> Full agent briefing: see `llms.md`. This file is the short, spec-format pointer version.
> Security work is defensive and restricted to project-owned code and explicitly authorized
> environments; see `Blockchain-docs/human/security/DEFENSIVE_SECURITY_SCOPE.md`.

## Start here

- [llms.md](./llms.md): full LLM/agent briefing — repository layout, implemented crates, security
  rules, coding conventions. Read this before anything else.
- [init.md](./init.md): human-oriented orientation to the monorepo layout.
- [PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md](./PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md): full public repository tree.
- [Defensive security scope](./Blockchain-docs/human/security/DEFENSIVE_SECURITY_SCOPE.md):
  authorization boundary for reviews, fuzzing, resilience tests, and security reports.

## Official execution plan

- [Blockchain-docs/internal/TASK_MASTER.md](./Blockchain-docs/internal/TASK_MASTER.md): the single
  canonical task tracker (`TM-100`–`TM-1800`, launch gates A–F). Not public; internal/agent use.
- [Blockchain-docs/human/release/NETWORK_MATURITY.md](./Blockchain-docs/human/release/NETWORK_MATURITY.md):
  the G0–G4 maturity/gate ladder referenced throughout the docs.

## Source of truth for protocol/product decisions

- [Blockchain-docs/human/source-info/](./Blockchain-docs/human/source-info/): `ALVENQIS_00`–`ALVENQIS_05`,
  the normalized canonical decision set.

## Rules that override convenience

- Never reintroduce `Veiron`/`Vireon` branding.
- Never treat ALVE balances as real funds in any generated copy.
- Never self-declare "Mainnet Candidate" → "Mainnet", "decentralized", "audited", or
  "0 vulnerabilities" — those labels are gated by `NETWORK_MATURITY.md` §4 and owner decision only.
